architecture_contract.native_backbone: unchanged published/native model; existing W/b/embedding/normalization objects retained
architecture_contract.private: added boundary R/S and delta_b only; existing native b remains shared
architecture_contract.factor_initializer: Fixed isolated-Torch-CPU-generator first-input R Rademacher; every other R/S one; delta_b zero; neutral-state construction law separate from actual sign start.
architecture_contract.native_hyperparameters: paper/native model settings and optimizer groups inherited exactly; no method-layer overrides
architecture_contract.serving: GNNM and ordinary I4 share mean native raw logits, then unchanged native output activation/interpretation; M1 source output unaltered
architecture_contract.new_native_preserving_wrapper_implemente: Portable core implemented; paper-preset native adapters/providers not qualified.

loss_contract.F: mean member native task loss with exact original masks/reductions
loss_contract.L: native task loss of inherited original GNNM served output
loss_contract.native_regularizer: unchanged original parameter set/coefficient included once in F and L, hence once in J
loss_contract.raw_logits: captured passively before native output activation; activation retained

methods.name: GNNM half own / half served-pool loss
methods.applicability: Any admitted native task with a differentiable fixed original GNNM serving map and native task loss.
port_changes: Attach loss to original boundary wrapper, never invoke install_factors.
Use the exact inherited original GNNM serving map in L; the multiclass probability-pool source is not copied when inherited serving is mean logits.
Preserve original native task reductions, target masks, optimizer and controller.
methods.prerequisite: Explicit per-preset native boundary/capture mapping and source frontend/provider; core implementation alone is not recipe qualification.

methods.name: GNNM private half own / half served-pool credit
methods.applicability: Same differentiable native tasks as global half-pool.
port_changes: Identify original boundary R/S/delta_b by actual parameter identity; all existing native parameters are theta.
Remove the internal-factor role and fixed alignment auxiliary from the source adapter.
Collect both block gradients from one old parameter state and then take one original optimizer transition.
Apply the exact inherited serving map in L.
methods.prerequisite: Explicit per-preset native boundary/capture mapping and source frontend/provider; core implementation alone is not recipe qualification.

methods.name: GNNM fixed private example responsibility

fixed_coefficients.weight_normalization: mean one within each native loss-reduction group and observed TRAIN class

methods.applicability: Categorical or binary observed TRAIN targets whose existing task loss exposes per-record terms. Exact source currently handles multiclass node CE; additional tasks need a reduction-preserving port.
port_changes: Replace FactorLinear/private-extra recognition with exact original boundary R/S/delta_b recognition.
Remove correction-site requirements and hard-coded M4/N580/C10 dimensions.
Retain native loss reductions; class normalization cannot replace a native positive/negative or observed-target reduction.
Draw once using an isolated deterministic RNG derived from the common run seed; persist the table as training metadata.
methods.prerequisite: Explicit per-preset native boundary/capture mapping and source frontend/provider; core implementation alone is not recipe qualification.

methods.name: GNNM own loss plus within-route hidden SupCon
methods.applicability: Single-label categorical classification only, with an unambiguous native prehead tensor and at least one nonself same-class TRAIN positive for every anchor. Not admitted automatically to links, multilabel tasks, or unverified model hooks.
port_changes: Capture the existing normalized native tensor immediately before the original boundary output map without modifying forward computation.
Generalize fixed N580 dimensions while retaining the full original TRAIN anchor/denominator law.
No projector, new view, added dropout, graph augmentation, context target, memory or inference correction.
Use original boundary factors; source wrap_shared/install_factors is not reused.
methods.prerequisite: Explicit per-preset native boundary/capture mapping and source frontend/provider; core implementation alone is not recipe qualification.
